name: unison-lyrics
description: Crowdsourced line- and word-synced lyrics from Unison (unison.boidu.dev), the Better Lyrics community database.
author: Community

settings.label: Prefer exact duration
settings.description: Send the track duration so Unison only returns entries within about 2 seconds of it.

settings.label: Show background vocals as separate lines
settings.description: Shows backing vocals as a small line under the main lyric. Turn off to hide them.

settings.label: Timing offset (ms)
settings.description: Shift all lyric timing. Negative = earlier (e.g. -300 if lyrics show late), positive = later. Default 0.

settings.label: Alternate sides for duets
settings.description: When a song has more than one singer, show the second singer's lines on the right.

settings.label: Word-by-word timing
settings.description: On: words highlight one by one. Off: whole-line sync only. Turn off to check whether a sync problem comes from word timing.
